sql:
SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fished_date_doy < 100 THEN 'd0-99'
       WHEN fished_date_doy < 200 THEN 'd100-199'
       WHEN fished_date_doy < 255 THEN 'd200-254'
       WHEN fished_date_doy < 311 THEN 'd255-310'
       ELSE 'd311+' END AS bucket,
  SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt) AS yt,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS rate
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=1
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
